summary: Iteration 12 backend regression — verified new IPTV country/genre enrichment on /api/livetv/channels + full regression on live favorites/recent, browse/rows, metadata endpoints. 18/18 pytest passed (10 new iter12 tests + 5 iter10 fav/recent + 3 iter11 regression). All IPTV channels now carry non-null string `country` + `genre` + `category_id` + `category_name`; classifier vocabulary confirmed; no channels emit unknown labels; USA/UK/Canada/Sports/News/Kids known mappings verified against actual provider catalog. Plex channels correctly omit the new fields. Mobile Fire TV UI was NOT tested (out of Playwright scope per request).

minor.issue: Returns 500 (bubbled httpx.HTTPStatusError) instead of 400/404 when Plex responds 400 for non-container rating_keys (e.g., movies). Not a regression — pre-existing at server.py:1560. Recommend wrapping plex_get in try/except to convert Plex 4xx into a proper HTTPException(404).

action_items: (Low priority, pre-existing) Guard /api/metadata/{rk}/children against Plex 4xx — currently 500s when called on a movie rating_key.
server.py at 2275 lines — still trending up; consider modularizing (live TV classifier / iptv proxy / me endpoints) into separate modules.
critical_code_review_comments: _classify_live_category is clean, deterministic and covers a good vocabulary; consider caching cat_by_id lookup across requests (rebuilt on every /api/livetv/channels call — one extra Xtream get_live_categories round-trip per request per user).
In live_channels: cat.get() fallback dict {'name': None, 'country':'Other', 'genre':'General'} is fine, but the case where cid is empty string still routes through fallback correctly.

The new fields (country/genre/category_id/category_name) are only added to IPTV channels — Plex channel dicts don't have these keys at all. Mobile client must handle missing keys gracefully (verify via ch?.country ?? 'Other').
logo_raw is unconditionally wrapped in /api/iptv/logo?u=... — if a provider ever returns an https logo it'd still be proxied (harmless, but wasteful). Consider only proxying http://.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (mobile Fire TV out of scope; web frontend regression skipped per main-agent instruction — no web code changed this iter)
